page.layout: One printed page of text, with a decorative woodcut frieze at the top, a heading, verse and a Greek epigram, then FINIS and a woodcut vignette below. Faint show-through text from the reverse is visible in the right half and is not transcribed. No margin notes, no page number, no running head.

main_text.l: MIRUM, qui moritur dat ipse vitam
Sint testes sibi mortuum esse vivum!

l.i: Cujus filo hoc qualecunq; φιλίας εἰλικινεῖς

page.notes: The Greek epigram line "φιλίας εἰλικινεῖς" and the signature "Ἰησοῦς Τονῖνος" are transcribed as best read from the scan; the Greek is uncertain at several letters. The frieze and the cherub vignette are woodcuts with no text. The faint background text on the right half is show-through from the reverse page and was left out.
